messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.  
If you need the precise time, you can:

1. **Check your device’s clock** – most smartphones, computers, and smart‑home assistants automatically display the local time for your time zone.  
2. **Use an online time service** – sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york) or the “World Clock” feature on Google will show the current time in New York (Eastern Daylight Time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving months).  

If you’d like, I can show you how to calculate sunrise or sunset times for a specific date in New York using the function I have available. Just let me know!
